content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Knoxville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's education and experience thresholds to confirm you meet the prerequisites. Gather your project documentation and timeline now—you'll need these details for your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all 35 required contact hours of formal education on a schedule that fits your work at TVA, ORNL, Covenant Health, or another Knoxville employer. Earn your course completion certificate upon attendance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Complete the official PMI application with your education and project experience details. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's platform. Submit before your preferred testing window closes—processing times vary, so plan ahead.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice assessments, and instructor support to build confidence. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE. Sit for the exam and demonstrate mastery of the PMBOK Guide and PMI's project-management standards.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout your three-year certification cycle by attending training, conferences, and projects. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting your PDU hours and renewal fee to PMI. Plan your PDU strategy early to stay current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
